user.title: Connect openGym
user.description: The address of your openGym instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:3000. This is the URL where openGym runs for you (browser address bar), not the GitHub project page.

pair.title: Pair openGym
pair.description:
1. Create a code: in openGym go to Settings → Integrations → "Pair the mobile app", generate a pairing code and enter it here (valid 5 minutes).

2. Set up the webhook (recommended so Home Assistant gets changes instantly instead of polling every {poll_interval} minutes): create a new webhook connection in openGym under Settings → Integrations → Webhooks pointing to:
{webhook_url}
Events: {events}. Enter the signing secret shown there below.

Without a webhook the integration still works — data is just refreshed at the poll interval.

reauth_confirm.title: openGym re-pair
reauth_confirm.description: The openGym session is no longer valid. Create a new pairing code in openGym (Settings → Integrations → "Pair the mobile app") and enter it here.
